reserveReview.rationale: At finalized Ethereum block 26236622 (2026-10-20T21:55:35Z; hash 0x942fd9743fc8fc922b4b1ef4058834d2a5254ce8dba3037cf1ad33f999e80fe5), assets() enumerated exactly USDC and WTGXX. totalSupplies(address) returned 79257405740616 USDC raw units (6 decimals) and 7412659588 WTGXX raw units (18 decimals). Normalizing the adapter's configured one-dollar denomination values gives 99.99999999999999% USDC and a positive WTGXX dust share of 9.352639691815362e-15%. The denomination-accounted total is 99.9994905369% of same-pin cUSD totalSupply 79257809529917609463722439 raw units. This is a reserve-category observation, not independent financial assurance or whole-chain liability reconciliation. Of the USDC accounting balance, 55993745324696 raw units are borrowed; available cash, fractional-reserve realization and borrower recoverability are not inferred from totalSupplies. The EIP-1967 slot binds the verified implementation cited above. The earlier WTGXX classification source is retained without claiming a newly observed fund portfolio.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Fixed-block Cap vault totalSupplies by accepted asset, valued at the adapter's configured one-dollar unit values and normalized across the complete assets() enumeration
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The vault's complete assets() enumeration contains only the two identified tracked assets. Borrower and fractional-reserve strategy risk remains a mechanism-level exposure rather than an unidentified reserve slice.
